title: Sequence composition and location of CRE motifs affect the binding ability of CcpA protein.
authors: Li, Dengke; Guo, Jiejie; Zhang, Zhiqiang; Liu, Yihan; Lu, Fuping; Li, Qinggang; Liu, Yexue; Li, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和自由能计算研究CcpA蛋白与CRE基序的序列组成和位置对结合能力的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非典型TF且偏工程应用。
abstract: Bacillus catabolite control protein (CcpA) mediates carbon catabolite repression (CCR) by binding with catabolite response elements (CREs) of genes or operons. Although numerous CREs had been predicted and identified, the influence of the changes in sequence and structure of CREs on recognition and binding for CcpA has yet to be unclear. This study aimed at revealing how CcpA could bind such diverse sites and focused on the analysis of multiple mutants of the CRE motif derived from the alpha-amylase promoter. Molecular docking and free energy calculation insights into the binding ability between the CRE sequences composition and CcpA protein. Disruption of conserved nucleotides in the CRE motifs, as well as altering the symmetric structure of the CRE sequences and the relative position of the displaced CRE motifs near the transcription start site contribute to some extent to weakening the strength of CcpA - dependent regulation. These main factors contribute to the understanding of the subtle changes in CRE motifs leading to differential regulatory effects of CcpA. Finally, an engineered promoter with a high level of transcription was obtained, and elevated extracellular enzyme activity was achieved in the expression system of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens, including alkaline protease, keratinase, aminopeptidase and acid-stable alpha amylase. The study also provides a reference for the application of other promoters with CRE motifts.
abstract_zh: 芽孢杆菌分解代谢物控制蛋白（CcpA）通过结合基因或操纵子的分解代谢物响应元件（CREs）介导碳分解代谢物阻遏（CCR）。尽管已有大量CREs被预测和鉴定，但CREs序列和结构变化对CcpA识别与结合的影响仍不清楚。本研究旨在揭示CcpA如何能够结合如此多样的位点，并聚焦于源自α-淀粉酶启动子的CRE基序多种突变体的分析。分子对接和自由能计算揭示了CRE序列组成与CcpA蛋白之间的结合能力。CRE基序中保守核苷酸的破坏、CRE序列对称结构的改变以及移位CRE基序相对转录起始位点位置的变化，在一定程度上削弱了CcpA依赖性调控的强度。这些主要因素有助于理解CRE基序的细微变化导致CcpA差异调控效应的机制。最终，获得了具有高转录水平的工程启动子，并在解淀粉芽孢杆菌表达系统中实现了包括碱性蛋白酶、角蛋白酶、氨肽酶和耐酸α-淀粉酶在内的胞外酶活性提升。该研究也为其他含CRE基序启动子的应用提供了参考。
